lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, forming a non-uniform grid pattern with higher spot density in the anterior-midsection of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally across the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light-scattering on the superior edge and deep shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, elongated biological silhouettes (commensal remoras) attached to the posterior edge of the pectoral fin and the lower gill region.
